market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: Crude oil has a history of severe drawdowns (e.g., 2020, 2014-15). With current spot near $70 and annualized vol ~35%, barrier option probability of hitting $40 within ~1.25 years is roughly 8-12% depending on drift assumptions, far above the 1.1% implied by the market. Even allowing for a lower forward vol or positive drift, the true likelihood appears significantly under-priced.
evidence_points: WTI fell below $40 in 2020, 2016, and nearly in 2015, showing clustered but real tail risk.
Using a driftless lognormal model with σ=0.35, the probability of touching $40 from $70 over 1.25 years is ~15%; drift adjustments still yield >5%.
The market price (Yes=0.011) implies an extremely low barrier probability, akin to annualized vol under 20%, which is inconsistent with recent realizations.
